component.name: Calculette
component.summary: Modern Standard & Scientific Calculator for Linux
Calculette simple et scientifique moderne pour Linux

description.p: Calculette is a fast, native desktop calculator inspired by Windows Calculator, built with Rust and Slint for Linux & Wayland. Features 128-bit exact decimal arithmetic, iconic Linux themes (Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox), full numpad support, and 6 languages.

Calculette de bureau inspirée de Windows Calculator, écrite en Rust et Slint pour Linux et Wayland, avec arithmétique décimale exacte 128 bits, thèmes Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, Dracula, Nord et Gruvbox, et 6 langues.

ul.li: Standard mode (immediate execution) and Scientific mode (operator precedence, nested parentheses, DEG/RAD/GRAD, 2nd & hyp)
8 built-in themes: Catppuccin (Mocha, Macchiato, Frappé, Latte), Tokyo Night, Dracula, Nord, and Gruvbox + 7 accent colors
6 built-in languages (English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese) with locale-aware formatting
Adaptive layout with slide-up drawer or side-by-side History & Memory panel

description.p: Native Rust and Slint interface. Cross-platform support for Linux and Windows, visual language flags and theme indicators, and CLI options.
Initial release featuring Standard and Scientific modes, 128-bit exact Rust decimal engine, 8 Linux themes (Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox), and 6 languages.
